title: Calculating Running Totals with Cumulative Window Aggregation
realWorldScenario: Finance needs to track cumulative daily revenue progression for delivered orders throughout February and March 2024.
questionStatement: Write a query on `orders` for status `'DELIVERED'` returning `id`, `order_date`, `total_amount`, and `running_total` (the cumulative sum of `total_amount` ordered by `order_date` ascending).
starterCode:
-- Calculate cumulative running revenue
SELECT
  id,
  order_date,
  total_amount,
  SUM(total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ASC) AS running_total
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'DELIVERED'
ORDER BY order_date ASC;
expectedConcepts: Implicit frame default (RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
hints: Use SUM(total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ASC).

testCases.description: Verify cumulative delivered revenue running total
